examples.text: "Dieses Steroid ist amphipathisch, besitzt also einen hydrophoben und einen hydrophilen Anteil, und kommt in der Linse in hoher Konzentration vor."

glosses: Describing a molecule, such as a detergent, which has both hydrophobic and hydrophilic groups.
Of the surface(s) on a protein, particularly an alpha helix, where one surface of the alpha helix has hydrophilic amino acids and the opposite face has hydrophobic (or lipophilic) amino acids.
